title: Hiseq 4000 Sequencing Protocol
author: Scott C Edmunds
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.q58dy9w
materials: Keep inspecting the Sequencing Analysis Viewer software to evaluate the metrics. Select Refresh at any time during the run to view updated metrics, and select the corresponding storage address of where to store the data. Select “Imaging” and also inspect the tile images to ensure the run is in normal progress.
When the run is complete, unload and weigh reagents, and then perform an instrument wash.

steps.title: Start sequencing run
steps.instruction: After priming and loading the clustered flowcells, select "Start" to begin the HiSeq 4000 sequencing run.

steps.title: Monitor run metrics continuously
steps.instruction: During the run, continuously check the metrics on the Run Overview screen, as well as the Fluidics and Imaging panels.

steps.title: Review First Base Report (cycle 3)
steps.instruction: When the 3rd sequencing cycle completes, the First Base Report dialog opens and the run pauses; review the report and verify that the Cluster Density equals 2353 and the intensity of each base exceeds 5000. If these criteria are met, select "Continue"; the run may also be left to continue without pausing, as the report can be accessed later in the appropriate folder.

steps.title: Check pF at cycle 30
steps.instruction: At cycle 30, click "Refresh" in the Sequencing Analysis Viewer to view the pF value. The pF must be greater than 50 %. If pF is below 50 % or if abnormal focusing, a decline in Q30, or low pF in Read 2 are observed, re‑hybridisation cannot be performed and the run must be aborted. If the results are satisfactory, select "Continue" and allow the run to proceed to completion.
